replies.author: Atmic
replies.body:
Yes, use Claude Code if you're serious about any project. 

...but I love the idea of the AI generated game platform. RoseBud, Teaana, Lovable all have tried their hand, but one backed by Google's infrastructure could actually work. 

The idea isn't to create professional projects, but to have an active community of game ideators just riffing and remixing everyone's projects in a creative maelstrom.

It's just a really fun concept that's finally becoming possible.
